Briefing:

The Lumen Ridge flagship store launch is planned around a store opening on Wednesday 24 March 2027. The approved project budget is €260,000, and the steering group approved a reduction of €59,000 to the project budget in March. The shop-fitting contract is worth €57,500. Rising wage costs could affect the budget. The figure of €260,000 is the budget as first approved, before the changes listed in this note.

Workstream ownership is settled. Joaquin Demir owns the shop fit-out workstream, Kwame Sørensen owns stock buying, Ingrid Szabo owns security, Yuki Kaur owns staff recruitment, and Rafael Achterberg owns the point-of-sale systems workstream.

The shop fit-out is scheduled to end on Thursday 25 February 2027. Working days for planning purposes are Monday to Friday, and there are no public holidays in this period. Late delivery of the till system could delay the store opening.

On staffing, the plan provides for 58 staff hires. An additional 2 staff hires were approved in March. Yuki Kaur's recruitment workstream covers this hiring, and the briefing material does not say anything further about how those two figures relate.

Stock loading can begin 3 working days after the shop fit-out ends. Kwame Sørensen's stock buying workstream is the one that connects to this step, so his updates are the place where the loading arrangements will be reported as they develop. All sign-offs, handovers, deliveries and meetings in this note take place on working days.

Several later milestones sit in the calendar after the opening. The marketing review is on Friday 30 July 2027, and the press preview is on Tuesday 14 September 2027. The fire-safety inspection is on Monday 22 November 2027, which falls within the security area that Ingrid Szabo owns. A delay in the signage permit could delay the store opening.

This note has been pulled together from the latest status updates and emails from the workstream owners. Figures and dates are quoted as they appear in those sources, and further detail will be added as each workstream reports in. Weaker footfall forecasts could affect the number of staff hires.

Write a memo to Bastian Petrov, the programme director based on this briefing. The memo must state:
1. the earliest date stock loading can begin
2. who owns the shop fit-out workstream
3. the project budget after all approved changes
4. who owns the security workstream
5. the value of the shop-fitting contract
6. the date of the press preview
